recommendations.title: AWS EC2, RDS, and CloudFront Migration Study
recommendations.what_to_do: Assess the current state of AWS EC2, RDS, and CloudFront configurations, identify inefficiencies, and propose a migration plan to improve performance and cost-effectiveness.
recommendations.why_it_helps: This project will help the student gain practical experience in AWS management, improve their understanding of cloud infrastructure, and prepare them for future projects involving AWS.
recommendations.resume_example: Migrated AWS EC2, RDS, and CloudFront configurations to a more efficient and cost-effective solution, resulting in a 20% reduction in costs and a 15% increase in performance.

recommendations.title: Implement a RESTful API with JWT Authentication
recommendations.what_to_do: Create a simple RESTful API using Flask, implementing JWT authentication for secure access control.
recommendations.why_it_helps: This project will help the student gain practical experience in backend development, specifically in implementing RESTful APIs and securing them with JWT. This task builds related evidence but cannot satisfy professional tenure, degree, citizenship, or clearance requirements.
recommendations.resume_example: Implemented a RESTful API with JWT authentication using Flask. Successfully secured access control with JWT, enhancing the security of the backend application.

recommendations.title: Develop a Technical Communication Workshop
recommendations.what_to_do: Create a workshop outline, develop slides, and prepare materials for a 2-hour workshop on explaining complex ideas to non-technical colleagues.
recommendations.why_it_helps: This project will enhance the student's ability to communicate technical concepts effectively, which is crucial for their future career in software engineering.
recommendations.resume_example: Developed a workshop on technical communication for software engineers, enhancing their ability to explain complex ideas to non-technical colleagues.

recommendations.title: Building a Simple Web Application for Resume and Job Search
recommendations.what_to_do: Create a simple web application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that allows users to upload their resume and job applications. The application should include basic features like uploading documents, searching for jobs, and submitting applications.
recommendations.why_it_helps: This project will help the student gain practical experience in web development, learn how to structure and style HTML/CSS, and understand the basics of JavaScript. It also aligns with the requirement for a degree in Computer Science or equivalent software engineering training. This task builds related evidence but cannot satisfy professional tenure, degree, citizenship, or clearance requirements.
recommendations.resume_example: A sample resume for a CSE student with relevant skills and experience.

recommendations.title: Django Web Application Development
recommendations.what_to_do: Create a simple Django web application that includes user authentication, a registration system, and a basic blog feature.
recommendations.why_it_helps: This project will help you understand the Django framework, learn about user authentication, and create a basic web application. It is doable in 2-24 hours and provides a measurable deliverable.
